title: Nullstellensatz degree under Hajós joins and vertex identifications
summary: We study the minimum coefficient degree $N_{k,\F}(G)$ of a Nullstellensatz certificate for Bayer's $k$-coloring equations, where the characteristic of $\F$ does not divide $k$. If $J$ is a \HJ\ join of non-$k$-colorable graphs $G,H$ and $m=\max\{N_{k,\F}(G),N_{k,\F}(H)\}$, then $N_{k,\F}(J)\leq m+k$. When deletion of the selected edge makes each input $k$-colorable, we also have $N_{k,\F}(J)\geq m$; the degree congruence then gives $N_{k,\F}(J)\in\{m,m+k\}$.
